hero.headline: Chandigarh Online MBA in Entertainment and Media: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: UGC-DEB approved 2-year programme with Harvard and PwC certification options

sections.tldr: A media business specialisation covering industry economics, OTT and digital content strategy, talent and production management, media law and intellectual property. Chandigarh University, NIRF Management rank 32, NAAC A+. Rs 1,75,125 after an early-bird scholarship of up to 25%.

about.body:
Media is an industry where the commercial logic is unusual enough that general management training transfers badly. Revenue is indirect, output is unpredictable, and the main asset is rights.

The subjects are Media Management, Entertainment Industry Economics, Digital Content Strategy and OTT Platform Management, Talent and Production Management, Media Law and Intellectual Property, and Advertising and Brand Communication in Media.

Media Law and Intellectual Property is the subject to weigh this programme on. In entertainment the contract is the product. Who owns what, for how long, in which territory, is the question every deal turns on, and it is rarely taught outside specialist courses.

Entertainment Industry Economics is the other. The economics of a hit-driven business, where most output loses money and a few titles carry everything, does not behave like the businesses management education normally describes.

Like aviation, this is a sector that hires on sector experience. The degree helps people inside it move up more than it helps outsiders move in.

Two things are common to every Chandigarh specialisation and worth pricing separately from the subject list. AI for Managers appears in all of them, so the AI exposure is not unique to the technical tracks. And CU sells the programme as two plans: the MBA plan, with a Harvard Business Publishing certificate, and the Triple Industry Certified MBA plan, which adds PwC India-branded certificates and PMI-aligned CAPM training. Ask which plan your fee quote covers.

Chandigarh University's NAAC A+ accreditation cycle carried a validity date of September 2026, so confirm the current grade at naac.gov.in before you rely on it.

Fees quoted here change between intakes. Confirm the current figure, which plan it buys, the early-bird terms and what sits outside the tuition with the university in writing before you pay.

syllabus.note: Sem 1-2 shared core subjects across all Chandigarh MBA specialisations. See the main Chandigarh Online MBA page for core subject list.

subjects.name: Strategy, Business and Globalization
subjects.desc: Media industry strategy, global entertainment market structure, IP monetisation, and platform economics.

subjects.name: Decision Science
subjects.desc: Audience analytics, content performance metrics, subscriber churn modelling, and advertising revenue forecasting.

subjects.name: Media Management
subjects.desc: Media company operations, editorial and commercial P&L, media brand management, and newsroom economics.

subjects.name: Entertainment Industry Economics
subjects.desc: Revenue models in film, music, gaming, OTT, and sports media. Rights valuation and content licensing economics.

subjects.name: Digital Content Strategy and OTT Platform Management
subjects.desc: Content calendar strategy, OTT content commissioning, streaming platform metrics (DAU, ARPU), and recommendation algorithm basics.

subjects.name: Talent and Production Management
subjects.desc: Talent contracts and management, film and series production management, co-production structures, and content delivery.

subjects.name: Project Management
subjects.desc: Film and series production project management, launch campaign management, and media product rollout.

subjects.name: AI for Managers
subjects.desc: AI in content personalisation, automated content moderation, AI-generated media, and algorithmic discovery management.

subjects.name: Media Law and Intellectual Property
subjects.desc: Copyright, performers' rights, defamation, digital media regulations, TRAI broadcasting rules, and OTT content guidelines.

subjects.name: Advertising and Brand Communication in Media
subjects.desc: Digital advertising models, programmatic buying basics, influencer marketing economics, and media planning for brands.

subjects.name: Capstone Project II
subjects.desc: Applied media project: content strategy, OTT product plan, media brand launch, or entertainment business model design.

whoHires.body:
This Entertainment and Media MBA syllabus maps to the following India's media and entertainment ecosystem:

**Industries:** OTT platforms, broadcast television, film production companies, music labels, digital media, advertising agencies, gaming companies, and sports media

**Entry-level roles:** Content Strategist, Media Planner, OTT Operations Executive, Entertainment Marketing Executive, Production Coordinator

**Mid-level roles (3-5 years experience):** Content Manager, OTT Product Manager, Media Agency Account Manager, Entertainment Marketing Manager, Production Manager

**Senior roles (7+ years):** VP Content (OTT), Head of Entertainment (media company), General Manager (production studio), Chief Content Officer, Media Group CEO

**How to check placement claims:** ask Chandigarh University for its latest placement report in writing, for your programme and mode. Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. Treat the roles above as the kinds of jobs this syllabus prepares you for, not as a list of who has hired from this batch.

skills.body:
The outcome is being able to structure and run a media business rather than only produce for one.

Entertainment Industry Economics covers revenue models across windows and platforms, the cost structure of production, and why portfolio thinking matters when individual outcomes are this variable.

Media Law and Intellectual Property covers rights, licensing, territory and term, defamation and content regulation. This is the most directly usable subject in the set.

Digital Content Strategy and OTT Platform Management covers commissioning, catalogue strategy, subscriber economics and the retention arithmetic that decides whether a platform works.

Talent and Production Management covers the operational side, from contracting through to delivering a production on a schedule that depends on people whose availability you do not control. Advertising and Brand Communication in Media covers the funding side of ad-supported models.

comparisons.body:
Comparing Chandigarh Online MBA Entertainment and Media against peer programmes:

**vs Amity Online MBA Digital Marketing Management:** Amity’s Digital Marketing Management programme at Rs 2,07,000 to Rs 2,25,000 is the closest Amity online equivalent for media-adjacent professionals, covering digital content strategy, brand communication, and social media management. It does not include OTT Platform Management, Entertainment Industry Economics, Talent and Production Management, or Media Law as dedicated subjects. For professionals in broadcast, OTT operations, film production, or entertainment business roles, CU’s dedicated specialisation is more directly applicable. CU’s NIRF Management rank 32 further differentiates.

**vs UPES Online MBA Digital Business:** UPES Digital Business at Rs 1,75,000-2,20,000 covers digital platform economics and e-commerce strategy. It does not include entertainment-specific subjects: OTT content commissioning, media law, talent management, or entertainment industry revenue models. For professionals targeting OTT platforms, media companies, film production, or entertainment business management, CU’s dedicated programme is more appropriate. UPES Digital Business suits general digital platform and e-commerce career paths.

**vs MICA or SIMC campus programmes:** These are top-tier specialised communication schools. Their brand is strong for traditional advertising and PR careers. CU’s MBA in Entertainment and Media is the right choice for professionals already in media operations, content management, or OTT roles who need a formal management credential while continuing to work.

fees.body: edifyedu.in rechecks fees with Chandigarh University Online every quarter. Please reconfirm current fees with our counsellor before any payment. Fees can change between intakes.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive a Chandigarh University MBA degree certificate with Entertainment and Media noted on the marksheet, issued under UGC-DEB 2020 standards. NIRF Management rank 32 and NAAC A+ credentials are recognised by OTT platforms, media companies, and advertising employers.

MBA plan graduates receive the Harvard Business Publishing certificate. Triple Industry Certified MBA plan graduates also receive PwC India-branded certificates for the two subjects taught by PwC India experts, and PMI-aligned training towards the CAPM exam. DigiLocker verification is available.

faqs.question: What does PwC India contribute to the Chandigarh Online MBA?
faqs.answer: In Chandigarh University's Triple Industry Certified MBA plan, two MBA subjects are taught by PwC India experts, and PwC India-branded certificates are awarded on completion. CU states that completing the PwC-led courses does not guarantee or directly lead to employment. The Triple Industry Certified MBA plan is Rs 1,90,400 after an Early Bird Scholarship of up to 20%.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the MBA plan and the Triple Industry Certified MBA plan?
faqs.answer: The MBA plan lists at Rs 2,33,500 and the Triple Industry Certified MBA plan at Rs 2,38,000. The MBA plan carries an Early Bird Scholarship of up to 25%, bringing the fee to Rs 1,75,125, with the Harvard Business Publishing certificate. The Triple Industry Certified MBA plan carries an Early Bird Scholarship of up to 20%, bringing the fee to Rs 1,90,400, with three certificates: Harvard Business Publishing, PwC India for the two subjects its experts teach, and PMI-aligned CAPM training.

faqs.question: Does the programme cover OTT platform business models specifically?
faqs.answer: Yes. Digital Content Strategy and OTT Platform Management in Sem 3 covers OTT subscription economics, content commissioning strategy, streaming platform KPIs (DAU, ARPU, churn), and recommendation algorithm management. Entertainment Industry Economics covers subscription vs ad-supported revenue models, content cost amortisation, and rights window strategy. These subjects are directly applicable for professionals at Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, Sony LIV, and other platforms operating in India.

faqs.question: Is this MBA useful for advertising and digital media agency professionals?
faqs.answer: Yes. Advertising and Brand Communication in Media in Sem 4 covers programmatic advertising, video ad formats, influencer marketing economics, and media planning frameworks. Media Management in Sem 3 covers media company P&L and brand management. Combined with the full MBA management curriculum, these subjects make the programme relevant for professionals in media agencies, advertising, and digital marketing who want a management credential with media-specific content.

chooseIf: You work in OTT, media operations, content management, or entertainment and want a NIRF University #19, NAAC A+ MBA.
You want the PwC India and PMI certificates of the Triple Industry Certified MBA plan alongside your degree.
You are targeting OTT platform management, entertainment business, or media company leadership.
consider: You need MICA or SIMC brand specifically for traditional advertising or PR careers.
You are targeting a creative or production career where portfolio and on-set experience outweigh management credentials.
Your budget is under Rs 1.2 lakh and a lower-fee NAAC A++ alternative is necessary.
